title: SF3142 (2021-2022 Regular): Non-in-person permit to carry renewals authorization

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2022-02-11; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/92/2022/0/SF/3142/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced version as filed (SF 3142, 2021-2022 session, dated 2022-02-11). Paragraph (e) is the only change to the section; the rest is unchanged law.

operative_text: Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 624.714, subd. 3): Applications for new permits must be submitted in person. Applications for permit renewals may be accepted in person, electronically, or by United States mail.
